_note: Match commentary. Placeholders: {team} {opp} = the side doing it and their opponents; {player} {player2} = from {team}; {oppPlayer} = from {opp}; {gk} = {team}'s keeper; {oppGk} = {opp}'s keeper; {me} = you; {mate} = a team-mate; {def} = an opposition defender; {home} {away} {stadium} {weather} {n}.
weather: It's chucking it down and the pitch looks like a ploughed field.
Bright sunshine, and the smell of fried onions drifting across from the burger van.
A biting wind is whipping in off the car park.
Lovely conditions. Someone in the away end has already taken his shirt off.
Fog is rolling in. The far corner flag is a rumour.
lineup: {me} leads the line for {team} today. Big afternoon for the youngster.
{me} starts up front for {team}. The gaffer has been fishing for goals all week, apparently.
kickOff: And we're under way! {team} get us started.
The referee blows, and {team} kick off.
We're off! {team} roll it back to the centre-halves, as is tradition.
possession: {player} picks out {player2} with a tidy ball.
{team} are passing it sideways with real conviction.
Patient from {team}. Very patient. Some might say asleep.
{player} tries a Cruyff turn and very nearly pulls it off.
{team} enjoying a spell of pressure here.
corner: {team} win a corner. Everybody up, including the kit man by the look of it.
Corner to {team}, swung in and headed clear.
foul: {oppPlayer} goes through the back of {player}. The crowd want blood.
{player} goes down a bit easily there. Free kick, though.
Free kick to {team} after {oppPlayer} leaves a bit on {player}.
yellow: {oppPlayer} is booked for a cynical trip on {player}.
Into the book goes {oppPlayer}. He's appealing to his mum in the stands.
Yellow card for {oppPlayer} for dissent. He called the referee something unrepeatable.
offside: Offside against {player}. He's still arguing about it.
The flag goes up, {player} was a yard off.
shotWide: {player} shoots, and it's closer to the corner flag than the goal.
Half-chance for {team}, but {player} drags it wide.
{player} skies it into the stand. A man catches it in his pie.
shotSaved: Good save! {oppGk} tips {player}'s effort round the post.
Big chance for {team}! {oppGk} spreads himself and blocks.
woodwork: OFF THE BAR! {player} so nearly scores for {team}!
injury: {player} is down. The physio's on with the magic sponge.
Stoppage while {oppPlayer} receives treatment. Possibly for his pride.
crowd: The {team} fans are in fine voice.
A chant of 'Who ate all the pies?' goes up for the referee.
A dog has got onto the pitch. Play stops. The dog is booked.
Mexican wave going round. It dies in the posh seats.
The {team} end are singing about the chairman. It isn't complimentary.
sub: {team} make a change. {player} trudges off, {player2} sprints on.
goal: GOAL! {player} heads in from a corner!
GOAL! {player} taps in at the far post after {player2} squares it!
GOAL! {player} cracks one in from 25 yards! What a hit!
GOAL! {player} pounces on a rebound after {oppGk} parries!
GOAL! {player} slots it into the bottom corner after a lovely move!
GOAL! {player2}'s cross takes a deflection and {player} bundles it in!
GOAL! A scrappy one, but {player} won't care. It's in off his knee!
GOAL! {player} converts from the penalty spot!
ownGoal: GOAL! Own goal! {oppPlayer} turns it into his own net under pressure from {player}!
GOAL! Oh dear. {oppPlayer} slices it past his own keeper!
goalReactionAgainst: Heads in hands among the {team} supporters.
Someone in the {team} end has thrown a meat pie.
stoppage: The fourth official holds up the board: {n} minutes added on.
secondHalf: We're back under way for the second half.
The second half begins. Same teams, same drizzle.
fullTime: That's it! The referee blows for full-time. {home} {hs}-{as} {away}.
extraTime: Level after 90 minutes. We're going to extra time!
Nothing to separate them. Thirty more minutes. The physios are sharpening their sponges.
extraTimeHalf: Quick turnaround. Fifteen minutes to settle it.
penaltiesIntro: Still level after extra time. It's going to PENALTIES!
It'll be settled from the spot. Somebody hold the gaffer's hand.
shootoutScored: {player} smashes it in. No mucking about.
shootoutMissed: {player} hits the post! It stays out!

ecstatic: "I'd mount that one on the wall, son!"
happy: "Nice and steady. Keep the line taut."
neutral: "Patience. The fish come to those who wait."
"It's like a slow Sunday on the canal, this."
worried: "We're fishing in the wrong pond here."
"Somebody check the bait, it's not working."
"I've seen more bite at a vegan barbecue."
furious: "You've let the big one off the hook!"
"My nan could land that, and she's allergic to fish!"

halfTimeTalk.winning: Half-time team talk: "We've got one in the keep net. Don't kick the bucket over."
halfTimeTalk.drawing: Half-time team talk: "The fish are there, lads. Change the bait."
halfTimeTalk.losing: Half-time team talk: "Right now we're the worm. Second half, we're the hook."

great: "That's a prize catch, that lad. Mount him on the wall."
"Best day's fishing I've had since Skegness."

poor: "He was about as much use as a chocolate fishing rod."
"I've had more threat from a pedalo."
